dag.description: Minimal deployable PyTorch pipeline: load Cradle training data, tabular-preprocess, train a PyTorch model, then Package, build Payload, and Register - with no offline evaluation or calibration stage. Smallest train-to-registration PyTorch flow.

agent_context.when_to_use: Train a PyTorch model on Cradle data and register it directly, with no offline evaluation or calibration step in the pipeline. Best for first bring-up / initial deployment, or when model quality is validated out-of-band and only a deployable, registered artifact is needed. Used by seller_grading (MfnReturns / SellerGradingImageValidation, NA Cradle path).
agent_context.when_not_to_use: Use pytorch standard_e2e if you need a PyTorchModelEval on a validation split before registration. Use pytorch complete_e2e or pytorch_percentile_e2e if the model needs probability or percentile calibration. Use pytorch_train_register_e2e_dummy if training data is pre-staged/uploaded (DummyDataLoading) rather than queried from Cradle.
differentiators: Smallest PyTorch train-to-registration flow: 6 nodes, no eval and no calibration branch
Cradle-sourced training data only (single data split)
Package and Payload both fan out directly from PyTorchTraining and converge at Registration

prerequisites.how: Cradle profile for the training window

safe_defaults: no calibration or eval steps to configure
common_pitfalls: No offline metrics are produced - validate model quality separately before promoting
Payload default_text_value must point at a representative inference input (seller_grading uses an image URL)
